1.explanation: ContextPadProvider.js is where getContextPadEntries is implemented and where the new “append anything” menu entry must be created and wired to the popup-menu service. index.js in features/context-pad is responsible for registering the ContextPadProvider and its dependencies; here we must add (or adjust) the registration of the new append-menu entries provider so that the context pad actually shows and is able to invoke the ‘append anything’ popup. Without changes to these two files, the append entry never appears and no menu provider is hooked up to supply the list of all possible elements.
1.bug_scenario: When right-clicking (or hovering) over a BPMN element, the small context pad appears but does not include an “append anything” (+) entry that, when clicked, would open a searchable “Create element” menu listing all possible BPMN elements. The attached screenshot shows the desired behavior (a plus icon on the pad that pops up a menu with search and all element types), but in the current build this entry is missing.
